title: Board Force Graph Dependency Free
description: Reimplement board force-directed layout in elements/client/lib/board/rs so the force_graph module uses no nalgebra or external math crate—plain f64 vectors only. Preserve behavior and existing Rust tests.
summary: Force-directed board layout no longer uses nalgebra: a private Vec2 (scalar ops + norm) backs the same repulsion, springs, gravity, and integration loop. Removed nalgebra from elements_board Cargo.toml; updated layoutBoardFixtureForceGraph doc in index.ts. Verified with cargo test -p elements_board (53), vitest (72), and wasm-pack release build.
